title: New Zealand Dollar grinds lower as US bond yields climb to new highs
summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) has its Official Cash Rate (OCR) at 2.75%, and markets now price at least a 75% chance that it goes to 3% on October 28, against about 30% right after the September 2 hike. NZD/USD is trading just above 0.5650, its lowest since late June.

title: Why a U.S. Diesel Export Ban Won’t Lower Fuel Prices
summary: As the national average diesel price soared to a record $6.52 per gallon, the Trump Administration sent mixed signals this week about restricting U.S. diesel exports. The White House has denied that an export ban is in the works, even if President Donald Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had hinted at the possibility hours earlier.
